modules.module_title: Measure and mark structural steel elements

pcs.pc_description: select the structural steel materials as per requirements and supervisor’s instructions
conduct linear measurements, such as length, width, diameter, using measuring tools, such as tapers, rulers, calipers, etc
determine the fit up requirements by reading and interpreting the relevant hand sketches/ drawings with the supervisor’s help
place the sections, plates, pipes or tubes in the appropriate position as per the given instructions
mark the position of bolts, plates or sections for fit-up as per the given instructions
ensure the markings are as per the relevant hand sketches/ drawings
identify and report any undulations or bends during measurements to the supervisor for appropriate corrective measures to be taken

modules.module_title: Follow health and safety practices

pcs.pc_description: identify potential hazard in the work area and report them to the relevant authority
follow appropriate safety measures while undertaking hazardous activities
use the appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as per the supervisor’s instructions
collect and dispose of waste and unwanted materials in an environment-friendly manner
ensure self-preparedness for emergencies by participating in safety drills

modules.module_title: Use appropriate tools and tackles in fit-up

pcs.pc_description: use correct tools and tackles for marking, liner and angular measurements, e.g. scriber, divider, punch, steel ruler, measuring tape, angle gauge, etc
hold and tighten metal pieces using the appropriate tools and tackles, such as wrenches, vices, clamps etc
cut and strike metal using correct tools, such as file, chisel, hammer, etc
use different types of lifting and shifting arrangements such as chain pulley blocks, trolleys, etc
perform basic maintenance of tools and tackles

modules.module_title: Shift structural steel sections

pcs.pc_description: determine the type of structural steel sections to be shifted
check the access route, and report any obstructions to the supervisor
perform visual checks on lifting tools and accessories, e.g. sling, rope, clamp, hook, etc., to ensure they are in usable condition
anchor the structural members in their right position during lifting to avoid accidents and overturning of lifting equipment
control the position of suspended objects during shifting by using tagline, mobile hydraulic lifting equipment, etc
stack heavy objects appropriately as per the supervisor’s instructions

modules.module_title: Prepare fabrication platform for fit-up operations

pcs.pc_description: clean the platform to remove any scrap metal and dispose it of as per given instructions
dismantle the previously installed temporary anchors and supports
check all the tools and tackles for holding, tightening, striking for their usability
rearrange all jacks, clamps as per requirement
clean the surface of the structural sections or components and the fabrication platform before welding, to ensure there is no obstruction in shifting of components
position the components/ sections on the fabrication platform as per the supervisor’s instructions

modules.module_title: Prepare the edges of the components of assemblies

pcs.pc_description: determine the edge preparation requirements by interpreting hand sketches and consulting the supervisor
mark the positions of the edges to be prepared as per the hand sketches and given instructions
determine the orientation of bevel and scallop from the supervisor
carry out scalloping and beveling by operating the bevelling machine as required, following the relevant safety measures
assist in checking that the bevel and scallop profile is as per the applicable requirements
assist in identifying any undulations or other faults in the section
carry out jacking or striking operations to rectify minor defects as per the supervisor’s instructions

modules.module_title: Position and fix structural elements

pcs.pc_description: position the structural components on the fabrication platform as per the given instructions, ensuring their correct position and orientation
assist in checking and ensuring that markings on the section are clearly visible before fixing the section
check that material has been scalloped, and edge preparation has been done as per the hand sketches or given instructions
place and tighten the clamps at the required positions to restrict the movement of section
place other components post dimensional checking on the fixed section as per the requirement and tighten the required clamps
adjust the fit-up correctly using striking, jacking or other methods as per the supervisor’s instruction
mark the locations for tack welds as per the given instructions
check the dimensions of the assembly after tack welding
remove the fitted section/ assembly by loosening the clamps, vices etc
lift and shift materials using ropes, belts or other appropriate accessories as instructed
